title: When the Summit Falls
author: Rosalind Joubert
blurb: Rafael Sterling, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
